sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Perception is a Mental skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Improves aiming concentration and makes detection of nearby loot easier.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases loot detection radius (2% per level → +100% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: Loot proximity notification

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Picking up all kinds of loot
- Completing the quest Profitable Venture
- Completing the quest Safety Guarantee
- Completing the quest Get a Foothold
- Completing the quest Profit Retention
